phrases.speaker: Sarah
phrases.text: It's always so quiet here. It feels wrong.

phrases.speaker: Thomas
phrases.text: Sarah...I try to put on this front of the perfect king. Even on the battlefield, I cover up my fears.

phrases.speaker: Carolyn
phrases.text: Aah, should I give up my secrets so easily to you?

phrases.speaker: Sarah
phrases.text: You're not asking me, I'm asking you...stay with me...please. Nobody else in this world has ever been so true a friend to me...more than a friend.

phrases.speaker: Garret
phrases.text: And as for the blood on your hands, what is a few drops more? Surely you don't mean to tell me that you have not killed others before?

phrases.speaker: Sarah
phrases.text: Each night when I touch myself, my only fantasies are memories of our encounters.

phrases.speaker: Narrator
phrases.text: When he would come to her, her heart ran fast in her chests. When he failed to show, she felt herself nearing to tears.
